description: "The Ocean of Theosophy" by William Quan Judge is a philosophical treatise written in the late 19th century. This work serves as an exposition of Theosophical beliefs, exploring concepts such as the nature of existence, the evolution of the soul, and the underlying spiritual laws that govern both humanity and the universe.
